style: Photoreal editorial fitness photograph in a minimal, dark home studio: matte charcoal wall and floor, one soft key light from the front and a single warm terracotta rim light from behind on one side, deep soft shadows, gentle film grain, true-to-life skin texture, calm and premium. The whole body is in frame with generous empty space around it, the floor line low in the frame, shot at hip height with a 50mm lens. Textbook exercise form. Colour palette: charcoal, warm off-white skin highlights and the single terracotta accent. No text, letters, numbers, logos, brand marks, watermarks, mirrors, screens or signage anywhere; clothing and equipment are plain and unbranded. Not a real or famous person.

people.man: an Indian man in his late twenties, short dark hair, neatly trimmed beard, athletic build, plain charcoal t-shirt, black training shorts, barefoot
people.woman: an Indian woman in her late twenties, dark hair tied in a low bun, fit build, plain terracotta sports top, black leggings, barefoot

images.alt: A man facing the camera driving one knee up to hip height
images.prompt: {man} facing the camera doing high knees on the spot: one knee driven up to hip height, the opposite arm swinging forward, standing tall on the ball of the other foot, a faint motion blur.

images.alt: A woman in a high plank pulling one knee in under her chest
images.prompt: Exactly side-on view of {woman} mid-stride in a mountain climber, the running plank: her hands are planted under her shoulders with straight arms, one leg is fully extended behind her, and her other leg is sharply bent with that knee tucked deep under her chest, the foot off the floor just behind her hands. The two legs make a clear scissor shape. Flat back, hips level.

images.alt: A man facing the camera in a side plank, body in one straight line
images.prompt: {man} facing the camera in a forearm side plank on a dark mat: supporting elbow under the shoulder, feet stacked, hips lifted so his body forms one straight line, top hand resting on his hip.

images.alt: A woman holding a wall sit with her thighs level with the floor
images.prompt: Side-on view of {woman} holding a wall sit against a plain dark wall: back flat against the wall, thighs level with the floor, knees over the ankles, hands resting on her thighs.

images.alt: A man face down on a mat, arms, chest and straight legs all lifted, only his belly and hips touching
images.prompt: Camera at mat level, exactly side-on, a clean profile of the whole body from fingertips to toes: {man} is lying face down on a dark mat, his body stretched out long and flat along it, in the prone superman back extension. His belly, lower ribs and the front of his hips are pressed into the mat and carry all his weight; he is not floating and not balancing on his toes or hands. From that position he lifts both ends of his body a little off the floor at the same time: his straight arms reach forward beyond his head, hands a few centimetres above the mat; his upper chest and head lift slightly, face down; and his straight legs, together, lift from the hips so his thighs, knees, shins and feet are a few centimetres above the mat, toes pointed back. Only the belly and hips touch the mat: the hands, knees and toes do not. The whole body sits in a thin, low band just above the mat in the lower third of the frame, a gentle banana-shaped curve that dips at the belly and rises slightly at the hands and the feet.

images.alt: A woman facing the camera pressing two small dumbbells overhead
images.prompt: {woman} facing the camera, standing tall, pressing a pair of small plain dark dumbbells straight overhead, arms nearly straight, ribs down.

images.alt: A man curling a small dumbbell with his elbow at his side
images.prompt: Side-on view of {man} standing tall doing a biceps curl with a pair of small plain dark dumbbells: elbows pinned at his sides, forearms curled up towards the shoulders.
